verdict: all 10 clips natural and pronounced right; voice kn-disha pleasant (clips in voice-picks/kn-review)

anchors.label: Opening
anchors.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ಸೀರೀಸ್‌ನಿಂದ AI assistant ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ. ಒಂದು minute ಮಾತಾಡಬಹುದಾ?
anchors.meaning: Hello, I am the AI assistant from Lakshmi Sarees. Can we talk for a minute?

anchors.label: Stock
anchors.text: ನೀವು ನೋಡಿದ್ರಲ್ಲ, ಆ green silk saree, ಇನ್ನೂ stock ಇದೆ. Photos WhatsApp ಗೆ ಕಳಿಸ್ಲಾ?
anchors.meaning: The green silk saree you saw is still in stock. Shall I send photos on WhatsApp?

anchors.label: Price
anchors.text: ಆ saree price ಎರಡು ಸಾವಿರದ ಆರು ನೂರು ರೂಪಾಯಿ. Photos, details WhatsApp ಗೆ ಹಾಕ್ಲಾ?
anchors.meaning: That saree costs two thousand six hundred rupees. Shall I put photos and details on WhatsApp?

anchors.label: Call later
anchors.text: ಸರಿ, no problem. ಯಾವ time ಗೆ call ಮಾಡ್ಲಿ? ಸಂಜೆ ಆರಕ್ಕೆ ಓಕೆನಾ?
anchors.meaning: OK, no problem. What time shall I call? Is six in the evening OK?

anchors.label: Not interested
anchors.text: ಸರಿ, ಅರ್ಥ ಆಯ್ತು. Disturb ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ sorry. ಬೇಕಾದಾಗ ಒಂದು message ಹಾಕಿ. Thank you!
anchors.meaning: OK, understood. Sorry for disturbing. Send a message whenever you need. Thank you!

anchors.label: Delivery
anchors.meaning: Your order will arrive on Thursday morning itself.

anchors.label: Reminder
anchors.text: ನಾಳೆ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಹನ್ನೊಂದಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ shop visit ಇದೆ. Confirm ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?
anchors.meaning: Tomorrow at eleven in the morning you have your shop visit. Shall I confirm?

anchors.label: One moment
anchors.meaning: One minute, I will check and tell you.

anchors.label: Owner call
anchors.text: ಇದನ್ನ owner ಗೆ ಹೇಳ್ತೀನಿ. ಅವರೇ call ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ.
anchors.meaning: I will tell the owner. They will call you themselves.

anchors.label: Are you a robot
anchors.text: ಹೌದು, ನಾನು shop ನ AI assistant. ಏನು ಬೇಕು ಹೇಳಿ, help ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
anchors.meaning: Yes, I am the shop's AI assistant. Tell me what you need, I will help.
